solution.title: Pre-Logon VPN Connectivity with Cisco Secure Client Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) via Microsoft Intune

products.name: Pre-Logon VPN Connectivity with Cisco Secure Client Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) via Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy Cisco Secure Client Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) to Windows through Microsoft Intune so the VPN tunnel comes up at the logon screen, before Windows sign-in — first remote logon, off-network password resets, and GPO all work from anywhere. Device-certificate lifecycle included, pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Bring the VPN tunnel up BEFORE Windows logon — on every managed device

A normal VPN can only connect after a user has already signed in to Windows — the wrong order for remote workers. A user who has never logged on to a device has no cached credentials off-network; an off-network password reset can't reach a domain controller; GPO and logon scripts don't process. This solution deploys Cisco Secure Client with its Start Before Logon (SBL) capability through Microsoft Intune, so the tunnel comes up at the logon screen as a “Network sign-in” (PLAP) option — before Windows sign-in — authenticated silently by a device certificate. Deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent Windows admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; the three things SBL actually needs (Core-then-SBL install order, UseStartBeforeLogon=true, a device certificate) are all automated, and every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates, including the decisive test: connect at the logon screen, then log on with the tunnel already up.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — why pre-logon matters (first remote logon, off-network password resets, GPO/DC reachability), how SBL works (the PLAP credential provider / vpnplap64.dll, the two required artifacts, Core-then-SBL order, UseStartBeforeLogon=true), how it's delivered via Intune, and why a device certificate.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Windows-only scope, Intune licensing + enrollment, Entra groups, a Cisco head-end, the Core + Start Before Logon installers, the SBL-enabled XML, the device-cert decision, PKI/SCEP, certificate renewal) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps: deploy the trusted root then the device SCEP certificate, package the Win32 app that installs Core then SBL and drops the SBL-enabled XML, build the Windows VPN profile, assign to a named pilot group, then validate, pilot, and expand fleet-wide — with Gates A–E.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — deployment-readiness discovery, on-device validation (client + PLAP/SBL + UseStartBeforeLogon + device cert), a coverage report, safe remediation of failed installs, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices and a folded-in certificate-lifecycle section so pre-logon keeps working.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The VPN tunnel up before Windows logon on every managed Windows device — delivered from Intune, authenticated by a device certificate, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SBLVPN-Discovery.ps1 — pre-logon VPN (Cisco SBL/PLAP) deployment-readiness discovery across Entra + Intune
    • SBLVPN-Validation.ps1 — confirm Cisco Secure Client + Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) are applied on THIS device
    • SBLVPN-Report.ps1 — pre-logon VPN (Cisco SBL/PLAP) coverage report across the fleet
    • SBLVPN-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix failed pre-logon (SBL) installs / missing profile assignments
    • SBLVPN-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the pilot (and production) Entra group(s)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
